subject.title: Dashboard: A2UI action-bridge capability — run canvas apps as dashboard widgets

question: Should OpenClaw sequence A2UI canvas apps as dashboard widgets behind the canonical browser Canvas action-ingress work, or sponsor a dashboard-specific bridge now?
rationale: This request spans product direction and a security boundary: it depends on an unmerged dashboard widget host and would route sandboxed/browser-origin A2UI actions through trusted Gateway/dashboard paths.

options.title: Sequence after Canvas ingress
options.body: Keep this issue open, settle https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 and the dashboard substrate first, then implement one dashboard bridge against that approved contract.

options.title: Sponsor dashboard bridge now
options.body: Maintain a dashboard-specific action adapter only if maintainers accept the extra review burden and define its security contract before code work.

options.title: Defer or externalize
options.body: If bundled dashboard widgets are not a near-term core direction, leave this for an external plugin or ClawHub package once the necessary APIs exist.

recommendation.title: Sequence after Canvas ingress
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, settle https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 and the dashboard substrate first, then implement one dashboard bridge against that approved contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest merged history around the current plugin-tab precedent and is the best visible routing candidate for whether this becomes a bundled dashboard capability.
